answer: Commit each identity to a sealed work plan: at epoch start an agent hashes the exact work it will do, like a knoll of stones marking one chosen path, and reveals the plan at epoch end with proof it was done. A lone agent plans honestly and keeps its word. A farm's clones must invent a distinct believable plan per fake and actually do it - copying one plan across the jetty of clones collapses them into a single sable thread, and inventing real work for a thousand fakes costs more than the reward.
